## Execution decisions

```text
Ruling: final whole-branch review precedes closing Task 6 and the parent — review is an acceptance prerequisite; final ledger completion follows the evidence commit.
Task 2: Ruling: switch the existing still-full check command to the validated coordinator in this task, before staged routing in Task 5 — the plan requires early parallel implementation-hook data but otherwise leaves those hooks serial; all coverage remains full. Cost if wrong: hooks are wired earlier, guarded by the inventory/cancellation and full-suite checks.
Final: Ruling: concurrency stability and post-remedy latency deferred by reviewer — acceptance is still required and will run on the corrected revision before incident close; cost if wrong: an unverified halt could be closed, prevented by the verifier gate.
Task 6: actual warm fast pilot 36.179s misses 35s headroom; measured new recipe-composition case 2.044s. Ruling: simplify its event markers to native shell built-ins rather than add runner/stage concurrency — preserve every assertion, native tt receipt and exit forwarding; cost if wrong: fixture encoding may weaken recipe coverage, checked by the existing 12 gate contracts and scoped review.
Task 6: merged current main into isolated worktree94d3585a; source auto-merges preserve latency changes, parent-record conflict retained every incoming note and generated report regenerated. Pilot146/full398 green. Scoped integration impl round5 accepted. Final: Ruling: unrelated incoming feature internals declined by integration reviewer — already landed on main and the complete merged suite is still required; cost if wrong: an unrelated latent defect may survive, without weakening this task's gates.
```

## Reproduction

Source mounted read-only into pinned Ubuntu dependency image and copied into a disposable Git repository. Private host-budget stub only supports focused host front doors; CI removes it from PATH. Full CI still overrides exported fast mode1; staged hook runs use no command overrides, the standard budget and shared timing log. The private index changes only same-line docstring whitespace, preserving report counts. The first verifier write was refused because it targets the registered stale main copy. A temporary per-invocation XDG_CONFIG_HOME registry retained all project mappings but directed material to this current worktree; the normal shared timing log stayed unchanged. Both actual verifier calls exited0 and the first recorded the verified note. No shared registry, launcher/config/service pointers changed. Feedback ops-64c0ed records the tool friction.

```text
import json, os, re, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path

mode=sys.argv[1]
results=Path(sys.argv[2]); results.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
commands=[('pilot', ['just','--set','one_cmd','env NIRI_TOOLING_FAST=0 python3 /tmp/material-ci-tooling-probe.py','test-one','--pilot'])]
locked='tools.test_optic_settling.DriverCleanupTests.test_term_with_the_session_locked_reaps_the_lock_client'
commands += [(f'locked-{i+1:02}', ['just','--set','one_cmd','env NIRI_TOOLING_FAST=0 python3 -m unittest','test-one',locked]) for i in range(10)]
full=['just','ci-tooling-test'] if mode=='ubuntu' else ['just','--set','fast_cmd','env NIRI_TOOLING_FAST=0 python3 -m tools.tooling_tests --full','test-fast']
commands += [(f'full-{i+1:02}',full) for i in range(5)]
records=[]
for label, command in commands:
 log=results/(label+'.log'); env=dict(os.environ)
 if mode=='ubuntu':
  env['TT_LOG']=str(results/'timing-runs.jsonl')
  if label.startswith('full'):
   env['PATH']='/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin'
   env['NIRI_TOOLING_FAST']='1'  # actual CI recipe must override this
 before=time.monotonic()
 with log.open('w') as out:
  run=subprocess.run(command,env=env,stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=180)
 content=log.read_text()
 record=dict(label=label,command=command,exit=run.returncode,elapsed_s=round(time.monotonic()-before,3),
             children=re.findall(r'Full tooling: \d+ cases, (\d+) children',content),
             locked_s=re.findall(r'case .*test_term_with_the_session_locked_reaps_the_lock_client: ([\d.]+)s',content),
             skips=re.findall(r'^SKIP (.*)$',content,re.M),
             verdict=re.findall(r'^(?:Ran .*|OK.*|FAILED.*)$',content,re.M))
 records.append(record); (results/'receipts.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n')
 print(json.dumps(record),flush=True)
 if run.returncode: raise SystemExit(run.returncode)
 if label.startswith('full'):
  if not record['children'] or not 1 <= int(record['children'][0]) <= 10 or (mode=='ubuntu' and record['children'] != ['10']):
   raise SystemExit('unexpected coordinator cap')
  if len(record['skips']) != (5 if mode=='ubuntu' else 2):
   raise SystemExit('unexpected skip inventory')
print('ACCEPTANCE: pilot, 10 isolated locked cases and 5 consecutive full runs green',flush=True)
```

### material-native-reference.py

```text
import json, os, signal, sys, time, traceback, unittest
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))
from tools.tooling_tests import RecordedResult, interrupt
signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, interrupt)
signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, interrupt)
result=RecordedResult(); before=time.monotonic(); interrupted=None
try:
    unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover('tools').run(result)
except BaseException:
    interrupted=traceback.format_exc()
finally:
    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,signal.SIG_IGN)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT,signal.SIG_IGN)
    for case in result.started: case.doCleanups()
receipt=dict(ids=[case.id() for case in result.started],ran=result.testsRun,
    skipped=[(case.id(),reason) for case,reason in result.skipped],
    failures=[(case.id(),detail) for case,detail in result.failures],
    errors=[(case.id(),detail) for case,detail in result.errors],
    expected_failures=[(case.id(),detail) for case,detail in result.expectedFailures],
    unexpected_successes=[case.id() for case in result.unexpectedSuccesses],
    elapsed=result.elapsed,wall_s=round(time.monotonic()-before,3),mode=os.environ['NIRI_TOOLING_FAST'])
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Ran',result.testsRun,'tests in',receipt['wall_s'],'s')
print('OK' if result.wasSuccessful() and not interrupted else 'FAILED')
if interrupted: print(interrupted)
raise SystemExit(0 if result.wasSuccessful() and not interrupted else 1)
```

```text
import json, os, signal, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time
from pathlib import Path

actual=Path.cwd()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='material-cancel-') as directory:
 root=Path(directory); (root/'tools').mkdir()
 (root/'tools/test_probe.py').write_text('''import unittest
class DriverCleanupTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_wait(self):
        import json, os, time
        from pathlib import Path
        from tools.test_optic_settling import DriverCleanupTests as Real
        real = Real('test_term_with_the_session_locked_reaps_the_lock_client')
        real.setUp()
        self.addCleanup(real.doCleanups)
        active = real.base / 'active'
        active.write_text('tty1\\n')
        driver=real.start('unlock', STUB_CAPTURE_S='600', DRM_OUTPUT='DP-1', DRM_MODE='3440x1440@59.999',
            VT_ACTIVE_FILE=str(active), VT_CHVT=str(real.stubs/'vt/chvt'),
            VT_LOGINCTL=str(real.stubs/'vt/loginctl'), OPTIC_SETTLING_STUB_TIMESCALE='0.05',
            OPTIC_SETTLING_STUB_CONSUMER=str(real.stubs/'tools/consumer.py'),
            OPTIC_SETTLING_STUB_LOCK=str(real.stubs/'tools/lock'), LANE_ARGS='--lane dedicated')
        def observe_cleanup():
            real.reap_driver(driver)
            real.assert_cleaned_up('unlock')
            Path('cleanup.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(driver_status=driver.returncode,
                remaining_stubs=[pid for pid in real.pids() if __import__('tools.test_optic_settling',fromlist=['alive']).alive(pid)],
                sockets=[str(p) for p in real.runtime.glob('gos.*')], assertion='production cleanup passed')))
        self.addCleanup(observe_cleanup)
        real.await_marker(driver, 'locked', 60)
        Path('ready.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(worker=os.getpid(), driver=driver.pid,
            stubs=real.pids(), fixture=str(real.base), runtime=str(real.runtime))))
        time.sleep(600)
''')
 env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH=str(actual),NIRI_TOOLING_FAST='0')
 parent=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-m','tools.tooling_tests','--full'],cwd=root,env=env,
                         stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
 metadata=None
 try:
  deadline=time.monotonic()+60
  while not (root/'ready.json').exists():
   if parent.poll() is not None: raise RuntimeError(parent.communicate())
   if time.monotonic()>deadline: raise RuntimeError('actual lock marker deadline exceeded')
   time.sleep(.02)
  metadata=json.loads((root/'ready.json').read_text())
  parent.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM)
  stdout,stderr=parent.communicate(timeout=30)
  assert parent.returncode != 0, (stdout,stderr)
  observations=json.loads((root/'cleanup.json').read_text())
  assert observations['driver_status']==143,observations
  assert observations['remaining_stubs']==[] and observations['sockets']==[],observations
  all_pids=[metadata['worker'], metadata['driver'], *metadata['stubs']]
  remaining=[]
  for pid in all_pids:
   try: os.kill(pid,0); remaining.append(pid)
   except ProcessLookupError: pass
  assert not remaining,remaining
  assert not Path(metadata['fixture']).exists(),metadata
  assert not Path(metadata['runtime']).exists(),metadata
  print(json.dumps(dict(verdict='PASS', coordinator_exit=parent.returncode,recorded_pids=all_pids,
       fixture_removed=True,runtime_removed=True,cleanup=observations),indent=2))
  print(stdout+stderr)
 finally:
  if parent.poll() is None: parent.terminate()
  try: parent.wait(timeout=30)
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: parent.kill(); parent.wait()
  parent.stdout.close();parent.stderr.close()
  if metadata:
   for pid in [metadata['worker'],metadata['driver'],*metadata['stubs']]:
    try: os.kill(pid,signal.SIGKILL)
    except ProcessLookupError: pass
```

```text
import datetime, json, os, statistics, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path

root=Path.cwd()
pilot='--pilot-fast' in sys.argv
extra='--extra-full' in sys.argv
results=root/('.superpowers/sdd/2026-10-04-pre-commit-tooling-latency-plan/' + ('amend-pilot-hook' if pilot else 'amend-final-hooks'))
results.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
report=root/'docs/materials/upstream-divergence.md'
saved=report.read_bytes()
records=json.loads((results/'receipts.json').read_text()) if extra else []
try:
 for route in (('full',) if extra else (('fast',) if pilot else ('full','fast'))):
  for iteration in range(1 if pilot or extra else 3):
   if extra: iteration += 3
   index=results/f'index-{route}-{iteration}'
   index.unlink(missing_ok=True)
   env=dict(os.environ,GIT_INDEX_FILE=str(index))
   subprocess.run(['git','read-tree','HEAD'],env=env,check=True)
   subject='tools/tooling_tests.py' if route=='full' else 'tools/test_gates.py'
   content=(root/subject).read_bytes().replace(b'"""',b'""" ',1)
   blob=subprocess.check_output(['git','hash-object','-w','--stdin'],input=content).decode().strip()
   subprocess.run(['git','update-index','--cacheinfo',f'100644,{blob},{subject}'],env=env,check=True)
   log=results/f'{route}-{iteration+1:02}.log'
   before=time.monotonic(); began=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
   with log.open('w') as out:
    run=subprocess.run(['.githooks/pre-commit'],env=env,stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=180)
   elapsed=time.monotonic()-before
   record=dict(route=route,iteration=iteration+1,started=began,exit=run.returncode,elapsed_s=round(elapsed,3))
   records.append(record);(results/'receipts.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n')
   print(json.dumps(record),flush=True)
   index.unlink(missing_ok=True); 
   if report.read_bytes()!=saved: report.write_bytes(saved)
   if run.returncode:raise SystemExit(run.returncode)
 for route in (('full',) if extra else (('fast',) if pilot else ('full','fast'))):
  print(f'{route} median {statistics.median(r["elapsed_s"] for r in records if r["route"]==route):.3f}s',flush=True)
finally:
 if report.read_bytes()!=saved: report.write_bytes(saved)
 for index in results.glob('index-*'):index.unlink(missing_ok=True)
```
